# OrangeHRM — Requirement Traceability Matrix

**Generated by:** [Test Design Agent](../../../prompts/testing/test_design_agent.md)
**Source PRD:** `artifacts/OrangeHRM/knowledge/OrangeHRM_PRD.md`
**Scope of this run:** Admin, PIM, and Leave modules only. Time, Recruitment, Performance, Directory, and Maintenance-as-a-standalone-module are **not yet covered** — a future Test Design Agent run should extend this matrix when those suites are generated.

Each row maps one PRD requirement (or PRD-referenced risk/journey item) to the manual test case(s) that verify it. "Assumption" in the Status column means the underlying PRD statement was itself marked `> Assumption`; the corresponding test case is tagged **Assumption-based test — verify requirement before execution** in its suite file.
